notes:
Typed page 17 finishes the characteristic-two automorphism calculation and opens §7, ‘Anneau des formes modulaires entières’. It defines forms by base-compatible sections of ω^{⊗n}, states Proposition 7.1 and begins its proof. The handwritten ‘pourquoi ?’ questions the claim that one may restrict to curves without additive fibres. The N.B. asserts multiplicity one and smoothness properties of divisors of c_4, c_6 and Δ on the modular site; its final exception names 2 and 3. These geometric claims are not independently established here. The proof explicitly says ‘Reste à prouver’ and continues on scan 33. Circles mark live letters, words and accents, not cancellations.
